meta.name: tfx-harness
meta.description: Use for meta-routing questions. Read the canonical routing SSOT and return exactly one branch and immediate owner; do not execute the requested work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 指明问题的处理分支和负责人
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常见的问题不知道找谁处理。
copy.tagline_en: Direct every question to its proper owner
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to know who owns a topic.

howto.what: 按此技能,当出现「该用哪个技能/路径」这类路由问题时,Claude 会读取路由规则文件,然后只返回一个分支和直接负责人,并标注可用性、回退提示与状态,不执行实际工作。
howto.when: 当用户提出「该用哪个技能」「走哪个分支」等元路由问题时触发;也适用于判断路径归属的询问。

say.text: 帮我判断一下:做数据清洗该用哪个技能?
say.note: Claude 会读取路由文件,返回一个分支和负责人。

say.text: 这是一个 which path 的问题,还是直接执行?
say.note: 若是路径问题,会以仅推荐状态回复。

say.text: 我不知道该走哪个分支,帮我路由一下。
say.note: 只返回唯一分支,不会执行任务。

howto.what_en: When a meta-routing question like "which skill/path?" arises, Claude reads the routing rule file and returns exactly one branch and immediate owner, plus availability, fallback notice, and status; it does not execute the work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks a meta-routing question such as 'which skill?' or 'which branch should handle this?', or asks about path ownership.

say_en.text: Help me decide: which skill should I use for data cleaning?
say_en.note: Claude returns one branch and owner from the routing file.

say_en.text: Is this a which-path question or should it just be executed?
say_en.note: If a path question, status is recommendation-only.

say_en.text: I don't know which branch to take; help me route.
say_en.note: Returns only one branch and does not execute the work.
